identification: Hand-knotted Persian Hossainabad (Hosseinabad, Hamadan province) wool runner, catalogued 280 x 78 cm. All-over small Herati (mahi/fish) repeat on a salmon-red field, cream-red guard line, ivory main border with dark red/black meander, dark red outer guards, short white fringes. Pile looks full, colours bright and even, no visible wear in the studio shots; looks late 20th century trade production (1970s-2000s), not antique. Current bid about A$240 (next increment 260), estimate 400-600.
